prompt:
A web console page for an autonomous software factory, seen whole. The top
bar is decided and fixed: one 44 px strip between two 1 px hairline rules,
quiet small-capitals words, no boxes or pills around links. Left to right:
"FACTORY CONSOLE" (the product name, slightly heavier), the project select
"ai-software-factory-code ▾", then the one bordered word "New task"; a wide
gap; the figures group "COSTS · METRICS · RESOURCES"; a wide gap; the
running group "SETTINGS · POLICY · NOTIFICATIONS"; at the right a moon
icon, "sebastian", "LOG OUT". The open page's word "METRICS" is cyan with a
short underline beneath it; no other bar word is colored. The page below
fills the rest.

The page's exact content, and nothing more — do not invent rows, sections,
numbers, badges, filters, search boxes, pagination or chart kinds beyond
the sparks the content names. Only the content between the CONTENT markers.
All text must be crisp and legible, spelled exactly as given.
Direction ROWS. The picked hierarchy, drawn strictly. One section per
family, small-caps label, then one row per figure between hairline rules.
Each row reads left to right: the figure's name in muted small text, its
value as a strong monospaced figure, its move against the previous window
as a short monospaced token beside the value ("+4", "−25 m"), and the 7-week
spark as a quiet trace filling the row's right end, aligned across every
row of the page so the eye can run down one column of sparks. No move shown
where the content names none. The window control sits at the top right of
the page head, three quiet words with the active one in the text colour.
PALETTE (dark, the console's default): page background #070b12 (near-black
blue), no page gradient; panel background where a surface is needed #0b111a;
hairline rules #1a2636 (1 px); text #dfe7f1; muted text #93a1b5; faint text
#7c8ba0; cyan #4fcbe2 reserved for the open page's word in the bar and for
links, nothing else; amber #f4b13e only where a state needs attention, and
sparingly. Sparks and bars are instrument traces, not decoration: they read
as quiet ink (muted or faint text colour), never as a saturated accent.
Words in a 13 px humanist sans; every figure, ID, unit and time in a tabular
monospace. Dense but calm: a mission-control readout, not a marketing page.
Rendered at 1440×900, desktop.
label: 13 rows dark
